description: Search live jobs on the 20 Locate Jobs Network job boards: Diversity Careers, Healthcare Jobs for Veterans, Nature Jobs, University Fundraising Jobs, Fiber Optic Jobs, Certified Medical Assistant Jobs, Forklift Jobs, HR Analyst Jobs, The Trades Jobs, IT Jobs, Optometry Jobs, Dentist Jobs, Funeral Service Jobs, Chiropractor Jobs, Veterinarian Jobs, SLP Jobs, Diversity Higher Education Jobs, Minority Finance Jobs, Bioinformatics Jobs, and Minority Jobs. Search by role or skill, by place (a city and state, a state, or a ZIP code, which searches its whole state), or for remote jobs. Returns 5 to 10 current jobs with title, employer, location, posted date, and a link to the job page on the board that lists it, plus a link to see more. It only reads job listings: it cannot apply for a job, post a job, or save a search.

limit.description: How many jobs to return, 5 to 10. Defaults to 10.

what.description: The role or skill, such as "dental hygienist", "forklift", or "payroll". Every word must appear in the job title or the employer's name, so keep it to the words a title uses ("help desk", not "IT help desk support role"). Leave out to list the newest jobs.

where.description: A city with its state ("Columbus, OH"), a state, a ZIP code (searches its whole state), or "remote". Leave out for the whole U.S.

name: search_jobs

location.description: City and state, a state, or Remote.

site.description: The board the job page is on.

url.description: The job page on our board. Share it as given.

seeMoreUrl.description: Our search page with more jobs like these.

title: Search jobs
